about_the_game:
Quick and Brutal Top-Down Shooter Roguelite set in the SINS OV CIGAR universe. Collect items, struggle, and "die" violently against hordes of bloodthirsty roided out bandits. The final game will feature a variety of new features, mechanics, locations, enemies, items, and characters; along with fully redone visuals.

Features:

- Heart-pounding combat with a focus on spacing, dodging, and strategic weapon choices

- Conquer the world as one of two characters (more to come!), each with their own distinct active abilities

- Slay enemies with bombastic and unique weapons

- Passive items that can change the way you play every run

- Play by yourself or with friends (locally on the same machine or online via Steam)

content_descriptors.notes: Depictions of violence using guns, melee weapons, magic, explosives, and fists. Frequent splashes of cartoony blood and gore.
